hierarchy.binding_rule: a surface primitive is rendered only when reachable from the selected scene, selected module, selected capability and selected atomic capability path

mappings.compatibility_rule: legacy surface type values remain valid runtime inputs; the stable surface primitive ID is an additive governance mapping and does not rename stored records or runtime selectors

surface_primitives.label: 今日行动
jobs: 汇总所选模块中今天到期或已过期且尚未完成的行动
在首页直接完成一项行动并同步回来源模块
无待办时引导进入所选首要模块而不伪造任务

inputs.eligibility: record has a valid due date not later than local today and is neither completed nor archived

state_model.source_of_truth: the selected module record; the home projection never owns a second completion state

recovery: exclude invalid dates without creating replacement work
recompute the projection from selected module state
on save failure retain the original incomplete record and announce the failure
offer navigation to the source module when the record still exists

responsive_rules.mobile: single column; summary and first real action appear in the first scroll viewport; complete control is at least 44px
responsive_rules.tablet: single or two-column composition with actions ordered before aggregate metrics
responsive_rules.desktop: primary action list remains ahead of analytics and secondary panels
responsive_rules.all: no horizontal overflow and action identity, due state and source module stay visible

accessibility_rules: completion controls have an accessible name containing the action identity
overdue state is expressed in text and not by color alone
save success or failure is announced through a polite live region
keyboard focus remains on a meaningful next control after completion

acceptance.check: every rendered item belongs to a selected module and satisfies the eligibility expression
completing from home changes the same source record and survives reload without a duplicate completion ledger
zero eligible records renders an honest empty state and no fabricated action

surface_primitives.label: 清单
jobs: 创建和修改可执行事项
完成、撤销完成、归档和恢复事项
保留日期与说明以支持今日行动投影
recovery: keep unsaved field values in the form
regenerate unsafe imported IDs
preserve the last persisted collection on mutation failure
allow export and later import recovery

responsive_rules.mobile: one-column editor and record cards; actions wrap without hiding labels
responsive_rules.tablet: editor may use two columns while records remain scannable
responsive_rules.desktop: editor uses available columns and record actions stay adjacent to their record
responsive_rules.all: minimum 44px touch controls, no horizontal overflow and no desktop table shrink-down

accessibility_rules: every input has a visible label
completed and archived states have text in addition to visual styling
edit and destructive controls name their action
validation and persistence feedback uses a live region

acceptance.check: all declared actions mutate the intended selected-module record
acceptance.evidence: positive and negative browser CRUD path

acceptance.check: create, state transitions and edits survive reload and export/import
forced storage failure preserves every entered field and the previous persisted truth

surface_primitives.label: 台账
jobs: 按时间保存事实记录
修改、删除和筛选本地记录
以原始记录而非推断结论支持后续复盘

inputs.custom_field_rule: selected module may replace the default fields only with validated supported field types

state_model.truth_rule: the persisted row is an entered fact; the surface does not infer professional, financial, medical or legal conclusions

recovery: retain the full form on save failure
keep the last persisted ledger unchanged
preserve unknown imported fields in legacyImport.unmapped
support export, confirmed import, immediate undo and clear with confirmation

responsive_rules.mobile: stack fields and ledger cards; filters do not obscure the first record
responsive_rules.tablet: two-column fields are allowed; record identity and actions stay together
responsive_rules.desktop: use wider columns without converting the ledger into an inaccessible dense table
responsive_rules.all: no horizontal overflow and full operation labels remain visible

accessibility_rules: labels and units are programmatically associated with values
filtering announces the resulting record state when it changes
record action order is stable for keyboard users
errors identify the affected operation without relying on color

acceptance.check: create, update, delete and filter operate only on the selected module ledger
known values round-trip through reload and export/import; unknown values remain quarantined and exportable
rendered outputs do not add a domain conclusion not present in a selected capability

surface_primitives.label: 阶段看板
jobs: 登记处于明确阶段的工作对象
推进阶段并保留下一步行动
归档已退出当前流程的对象

state_model.transition_rule: move advances within the selected module's declared stage order and never moves a different record

recovery: reject unknown stages without silently choosing one
retain the prior stage when a move cannot be saved
re-render from persisted selected-module state
offer edit or archive only for the same identified record

responsive_rules.mobile: render as vertically ordered stage cards rather than horizontally compressed columns
responsive_rules.tablet: allow compact columns only when every stage and action remains readable
responsive_rules.desktop: columns or record rows may be used while keeping the next action adjacent
responsive_rules.all: stage order remains the same and no horizontal overflow is introduced

accessibility_rules: stage is present in text and not encoded only by position or color
move control announces the destination stage
keyboard order follows the declared stage order
save failure is announced while the prior stage stays visible

acceptance.check: move follows the declared order and persists after reload
all actions preserve record and selected-module identity
all stages and actions are usable at the mobile viewport without a desktop board shrink-down

surface_primitives.label: 指标
jobs: 记录有名称、数值和可选单位的观察值
按日期和关键词筛选指标记录
展示只由所选记录计算的可追踪摘要

inputs.number_rule: value must normalize to a finite number before persistence

state_model.truth_rule: displayed summaries are derived only from selected local rows and are not forecasts, diagnoses or guarantees

recovery: reject non-finite values and preserve the entered fields
show the raw unit beside every value used in an aggregate
fall back to the persisted rows when an aggregate cannot be calculated
keep the last persisted metric set on write failure

responsive_rules.mobile: numeric input uses an appropriate keypad and a minimum 16px font; cards precede charts
responsive_rules.tablet: summary and recent values may form two columns without hiding units
responsive_rules.desktop: analytics remain secondary to the primary task and source rows remain reachable
responsive_rules.all: charts are optional, textual values are required and no horizontal overflow is allowed

accessibility_rules: metric name, value and unit have a readable textual representation
any chart has an equivalent textual summary
trend or threshold meaning is not conveyed by color alone
invalid numeric input identifies the field and required correction

acceptance.check: finite values and units persist without changing meaning across reload and export/import
invalid values do not replace persisted truth and the complete form remains available
acceptance.evidence: negative input and storage failure cases

acceptance.check: every displayed aggregate can be recomputed from selected visible-source rows

surface_primitives.label: 回顾

筛选历史回顾并回到相关行动
把事实、解释和下一步分开呈现

inputs.context_rule: any projected facts must be reachable from selected modules; user-authored conclusions remain visibly authored conclusions

state_model.truth_rule: a review is interpretation over cited local facts and never rewrites the underlying completion, mastery or ledger truth

recovery: retain the complete draft when validation or persistence fails
remove an unreachable projection without deleting its source record
recompute facts from selected module state
support export and import recovery

responsive_rules.mobile: one focused prompt at a time with conclusion before supporting history
responsive_rules.tablet: draft and supporting facts may be adjacent if reading order remains linear
responsive_rules.desktop: history may use a secondary pane but cannot displace the current review task
responsive_rules.all: long text wraps, remains zoomable and never requires horizontal scrolling

accessibility_rules: prompts, authored text and projected facts have distinct headings
textarea labels remain visible while editing
save status is announced and focus remains in the draft on failure
history filters and results have a logical keyboard order

acceptance.check: authored conclusions are visually distinct from source facts and do not mutate them
forced save failure preserves date, conclusion and next action values
entries survive reload and export/import with their field meanings intact

surface_primitives.label: 资料库
jobs: 浏览所选能力随附的内置参考内容
按来源边界、主题和状态查找材料
记录已查看状态但不把查看等同于掌握或完成真实工作

state_model.truth_rule: content provenance and boundary come from the frozen selected content contract; viewed state is user progress only

recovery: refuse unselected content instead of falling back to the full catalog
show a source-boundary error without inventing provenance
keep text usable when local speech synthesis is unavailable
retain the previous reviewed state on persistence failure

responsive_rules.mobile: single-column cards with readable text and controls following the item
responsive_rules.tablet: two-column browsing is allowed while an opened item uses a readable single content column
responsive_rules.desktop: index and detail may be adjacent but keyboard reading order follows index then active detail
responsive_rules.all: content remains zoomable, long URLs wrap and no source disclosure is clipped

accessibility_rules: each item has a unique accessible title
opened and reviewed states are expressed in text
expandable content uses native details or equivalent expanded state
read-aloud failure never blocks visual access to the same text

acceptance.check: rendered item IDs equal the selected content item set and no catalog-only item is serialized
acceptance.evidence: compiled payload and DOM identity comparison

acceptance.check: every opened item exposes its declared source boundary without unsupported authority or license claims
disabling speech synthesis leaves all content and reviewed controls usable

surface_primitives.label: 引导练习
jobs: 用单题或单任务流程完成一次可反馈练习
在提交后显示对错、答案、解析、知识点、难度与来源标签
保存续做位置和错题记录但不擅自写入独立掌握结论

inputs.truth_boundary: selected sealed answer or deterministic generator truth is authoritative for the attempt; the surface cannot change it

state_model.progress_rule: attempt and resume state may persist; guided practice alone is not independent mastery or guardian verification

recovery: block the affected item when answer truth is missing rather than guess
preserve the current answer on submit or persistence failure
return to the same selected item after reload when resume state is valid
require the declared guardian confirmation before completing an offscreen action

responsive_rules.mobile: one item per screen; large options or an in-page numeric keypad; feedback appears below the answered item without obstruction
responsive_rules.tablet: keep the same single-item flow with optional adjacent hint or reference panel
responsive_rules.desktop: supporting explanation may be adjacent but cannot reveal the answer before submit
responsive_rules.all: controls are at least 44px, animations respect reduced motion and the next item resets transient feedback

accessibility_rules: answer controls expose prompt context, selected state and disabled state
correctness is announced in text and through a live region, not color alone
semantic visuals have a non-empty accessible name that matches the prompt
keyboard users can answer, submit, read feedback and continue in logical order

acceptance.check: independent recomputation agrees with every accepted answer and every wrong answer is rejected
acceptance.evidence: sealed truth plus positive and negative interaction cases

acceptance.check: attempt, hint, correct answer and refresh never mutate mastery, completion evidence or guardian verification
the complete answer-feedback-next path succeeds on mobile, tablet and desktop without answer leakage or overflow

surface_primitives.label: 奖励兑换

提交一次本地兑换意图并展示结果
允许成人维护家庭自定义奖励目录而不接入支付或交易

state_model.business_truth_owner: policy-bound local reward ledger outside the presentation state
truth_invariants: reward balance never changes completion evidence
reward redemption never changes domain business records
no external fulfillment, payment or merchant transaction is implied

recovery: reject insufficient or unauthorized redemption without changing the ledger
use a command identity to prevent duplicate deduction
on write failure preserve the previous balance and history
allow an adult to cancel or reverse a reversible local reward according to policy

responsive_rules.tablet: catalog may use two columns; adult editing remains separated from child-facing browsing
responsive_rules.desktop: balance and history may be supporting panels while the active redemption remains primary
responsive_rules.all: insufficient state is textual, controls are at least 44px and no cost or confirmation is clipped

balance changes and failures are announced through a live region
disabled redemption exposes the insufficient-balance reason
adult-only controls are absent from the child interaction scope rather than merely color-coded

acceptance.check: successful and failed redemption change only the reward ledger fields and never mastery, completion or domain records
a successful command deducts exactly once and a failed write deducts zero times after reload
acceptance.evidence: success, duplicate and forced-failure browser cases

acceptance.check: candidate contains no payment, merchant, purchase or transferable-asset operation
